name: Konrad von Gundelfingen
note: rival claimant (anti-abbot sponsored by Rudolf I of Germany)

name: Ulrich Rösch
note: Bought the county of Toggenburg. In 1487 he built a monastery at Rorschach.

name: Franz von Gaisberg
note: Abbot when the Reformation took place.

name: Kilian Germann
note: Elected to prevent the Reformation from entering the Abbey.

name: Diethelm Blarer von Wartensee
note: Expanded the Abbey, known as the Third Founder due to his work on the Abbey.

name: Pankraz Vorster
note: last prince-abbot; in 1798 the Prince-Abbot's secular power was suppressed and the abbey secularized (list runs to 1805)
